items.title_cn: 希奇莱马连任赞比亚总统，反对派拟挑战选举结果
items.title_original: Hakainde Hichilema re-elected as Zambia president amid opposition challenge concerns
items.summary_cn: 赞比亚选举委员会宣布总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马以约60%的有效票赢得连任；主要挑战者Brian Mundubile表示将提出法律挑战并指称存在违规。
items.summary_original: Zambia's electoral commission declared President Hakainde Hichilema re-elected for a second term with roughly 60% of valid votes, while challenger Brian Mundubile signalled a legal challenge and alleged irregularities.
verification_notes: Opposition allegations of irregularities had not been judicially resolved at publication time.
uncertainties: Opposition allegations of irregularities had not been judicially resolved at publication time.

timeline_updates.title_cn: 赞比亚前部长在与反对派有关的安全突袭中死亡
timeline_updates.title_original: Former Zambian minister killed in security raid linked to opposition
timeline_updates.summary_cn: 赞比亚当局称，前部长Mutotwe Kafwaya在针对与反对派领导人Brian Mundubile有关住所的安全行动中受致命伤。11人被捕；当局关于“叛乱活动”的指控遭反对派否认。
timeline_updates.summary_original: Authorities said former minister Mutotwe Kafwaya was fatally wounded during a security operation at a property linked to opposition leader Brian Mundubile. Eleven people were arrested; insurgency-related allegations were disputed by the opposition.
verification_notes: Insurgency allegations were disputed and had not been independently established.
uncertainties: Insurgency allegations were disputed and had not been independently established.

timeline_updates.title_cn: 赞比亚在反对派挑战选举结果最后期限当天关闭最高层级法院
timeline_updates.title_original: Zambia closes top courts on final day for opposition election challenge
timeline_updates.summary_cn: 赞比亚最高层级法院（包括宪法法院）以安全原因关闭，时间恰逢反对派就8月13日选举结果提出法律挑战的最后期限，引发对司法救济渠道受限的担忧。
timeline_updates.summary_original: Zambia's top courts, including the Constitutional Court, were closed for stated security reasons on the final day the opposition could file a challenge to the August 13 election results, raising concerns about access to legal remedies.
verification_notes: Authorities cited security assessments; intent to obstruct the petition was alleged by critics but not established.
uncertainties: Authorities cited security assessments; intent to obstruct the petition was alleged by critics but not established.

timeline_updates.title_cn: 赞比亚反对派领导人因涉嫌叛国罪被警方拘留讯问
timeline_updates.title_original: Zambian opposition leader questioned in custody over alleged treason
timeline_updates.summary_cn: 赞比亚反对派领导人Brian Mundubile及其竞选搭档Makebi Zulu因涉嫌叛国罪被警方拘留讯问，警方已记录“警告与告诫”陈述，但具体指控细节仍不清晰。
timeline_updates.summary_original: Opposition leader Brian Mundubile and running mate Makebi Zulu were in police custody after questioning over alleged treason. Police recorded warn-and-caution statements; details of the allegations remained unclear.
verification_notes: The treason allegations remained unclear and had not been tested in court.
uncertainties: The treason allegations remained unclear and had not been tested in court.

items.title_cn: 尼日利亚高原州村庄遭袭，至少25人死亡
items.title_original: At least 25 killed in attack on village in Nigeria's Plateau State
items.summary_cn: 当地官员和居民称，尼日利亚高原州一座村庄遭夜间袭击，至少25人死亡；事件加剧当地发生报复性暴力的担忧。
items.summary_original: Local officials and residents said at least 25 people were killed in an overnight attack in Plateau State, increasing fears of retaliatory violence in a region repeatedly affected by farmer-herder and communal conflict.
items.location: Bin-Per village, Mangu LGA, Plateau State
items.location_name: Bin-Per village, Mangu LGA, Plateau State
verification_notes: Responsibility for the attack was not definitively established in the cited reports.
uncertainties: Responsibility for the attack was not definitively established in the cited reports.

items.title_cn: 中非共和国非法金矿坍塌，至少100人死亡
items.title_original: Illegal gold mine collapse in Central African Republic kills at least 100
items.summary_cn: 靠近喀麦隆边境的Zamboye手工采金点发生山体滑坡及坑道坍塌，造成至少100人死亡；救援仍在继续，最终伤亡数字可能变化。
items.summary_original: A landslide and tunnel collapse at the Zamboye artisanal gold-mining site near the Cameroon border killed at least 100 people, with rescue efforts continuing and the final toll uncertain.
items.location: Zamboye mining site near Baboua, Nana-Mambéré
items.location_name: Zamboye mining site near Baboua, Nana-Mambéré
verification_notes: Final death toll remained subject to rescue and official confirmation.
uncertainties: Final death toll remained subject to rescue and official confirmation.

items.title_cn: 尼日利亚总统选举竞选启动，经济与安全议题成为焦点
items.title_original: Nigeria's presidential election campaign begins amid economic and security pressures
items.summary_cn: 尼日利亚总统选举竞选活动启动，通胀、生活成本以及多重安全危机预计将成为主要选举议题。
items.summary_original: Campaigning began ahead of Nigeria's presidential election, with inflation, living costs and multiple security crises expected to shape the race.

items.title_cn: 法国确认两名公民自7月27日起在多哥被拘留
items.title_original: France confirms two nationals have been detained in Togo since July 27
items.summary_cn: 法国外交部确认，两名法国记者兼导演自7月27日起一直被多哥方面拘留，并受到司法调查。
items.summary_original: France's foreign ministry confirmed that two French journalist-directors had been detained in Togo since July 27 and were subject to a judicial investigation.
verification_notes: Specific allegations and case details were limited in initial public statements.
uncertainties: Specific allegations and case details were limited in initial public statements.

items.title_cn: 尼日利亚索科托州船只倾覆，至少50人死亡，多数为儿童
items.title_original: At least 50 killed, mostly children, in Nigeria boat capsize
items.summary_cn: 一艘超载船只在尼日利亚索科托州Gorau附近倾覆，造成至少50人死亡，其中许多为儿童；事故后救援继续进行。
items.summary_original: An overloaded boat capsized near Gorau in Sokoto State, killing at least 50 people, many of them children. Rescue operations continued after the accident.
verification_notes: Final toll could change as rescue operations continued.
uncertainties: Final toll could change as rescue operations continued.

items.title_cn: 紫金黄金收购股权，间接取得靠近苏丹战区的埃塞俄比亚金矿项目权益
items.title_original: China-linked Zijin Gold acquires stake giving exposure to Ethiopian mine near Sudan war zone
items.summary_cn: 紫金黄金国际收购Allied Gold约9.2%股权，从而获得包括靠近苏丹边境的埃塞俄比亚Kurmuk金矿项目在内的资产组合权益。所引资料未报告针对该涉中资产的直接袭击。
items.summary_original: Zijin Gold International acquired a 9.2% stake in Allied Gold, gaining exposure to a portfolio including the Kurmuk gold project in Ethiopia near the Sudan border. No attack on the Chinese-linked asset was reported.
items.location: Benishangul-Gumuz / Kurmuk area near Sudan border
items.location_name: Benishangul-Gumuz / Kurmuk area near Sudan border
verification_notes: Security implications are indirect; no direct attack on the asset was reported.
uncertainties: Security implications are indirect; no direct attack on the asset was reported.

items.title_cn: 博尔诺州被绑儿童失踪近百日，家属抗议要求政府营救
items.title_original: Families protest over children abducted nearly 100 days earlier in Borno State
items.summary_cn: 5月在Mussa遭绑架儿童的家属在Uba举行抗议，要求政府采取行动营救。当地代表称仍约有45名儿童下落不明。
items.summary_original: Families of children abducted from Mussa in May protested in Uba, demanding action to secure their release. Local representatives said around 45 children remained unaccounted for.
verification_notes: The figure of around 45 still missing came from local representatives and could change.
uncertainties: The figure of around 45 still missing came from local representatives and could change.

items.title_cn: 突尼斯首都爆发反对派抗议，聚焦停电停水、物价与政治限制
items.title_original: Opposition protest in Tunis targets power and water cuts, prices and political restrictions
items.summary_cn: 在极端高温、电力配给、供水短缺和生活成本压力背景下，一个反对派团体在突尼斯市组织抗议，部分示威者要求总统凯斯·赛义德下台。
items.summary_original: An opposition collective mobilized protesters in Tunis amid extreme heat, electricity rationing, water shortages and living-cost pressures. Some demonstrators called on President Kais Saied to leave power.

items.title_cn: 利比里亚前副总统Jewel Howard-Taylor在跨国毒品案件中被起诉
items.title_original: Liberia charges former vice president Jewel Howard-Taylor in drug-trafficking probe
items.summary_cn: 利比里亚当局在Roberts国际机场拘留前副总统Jewel Howard-Taylor后，以毒品贩运、洗钱等罪名对其提出指控；相关指控属于更广泛的跨国毒品网络调查。
items.summary_original: Liberian authorities charged former Vice President Jewel Howard-Taylor with drug trafficking, money laundering and related offences after detaining her at Roberts International Airport. The allegations form part of a broader transnational narcotics investigation.
verification_notes: Charges are allegations; guilt has not been established by a court.
uncertainties: Charges are allegations; guilt has not been established by a court.

items.title_cn: 人权观察指称“非洲军团”人员在马里中部杀害9名平民
items.title_original: HRW alleges Africa Corps personnel killed nine civilians in central Mali
items.summary_cn: 人权观察组织指称，俄罗斯“非洲军团”人员在马里士兵陪同下于7月在Mopti地区Bombori行动中杀害9名平民，其中包括4名儿童；该指控在本次回填窗口内公开。
items.summary_original: Human Rights Watch alleged that Russian Africa Corps personnel, accompanied by Malian soldiers, killed nine civilians including four children during a July operation in Bombori, Mopti Region. The allegation was published during the backfill window.
verification_notes: This is an allegation regarding an earlier operation and was not independently adjudicated in the cited material.
uncertainties: This is an allegation regarding an earlier operation and was not independently adjudicated in the cited material.

items.title_cn: 坦桑尼亚高等法院裁定反对派领导人Tundu Lissu叛国案需进入答辩阶段
items.title_original: Tanzania High Court rules opposition leader Tundu Lissu has a case to answer for treason
items.summary_cn: 坦桑尼亚高等法院三人合议庭裁定，检方已提交足以要求反对派领导人Tundu Lissu进入答辩阶段的证据；该裁定并不等同于定罪。
items.summary_original: A three-judge High Court panel ruled that prosecutors had presented enough evidence to require opposition leader Tundu Lissu to enter a defence in his treason case. The ruling was not a conviction.
verification_notes: The ruling is procedural and does not establish guilt.
uncertainties: The ruling is procedural and does not establish guilt.

items.title_cn: Bentiu流离失所者营地发生致命事件后，UNMISS加强巡逻
items.title_original: UNMISS increases patrols after deadly incident in Bentiu IDP camp
items.summary_cn: 联合国南苏丹特派团表示，8月19日Bentiu流离失所者营地发生造成人员死亡的事件后，特派团已加强营地周边巡逻和降级冲突措施。
items.summary_original: UNMISS said it strengthened patrols and de-escalation efforts around the Bentiu camp for internally displaced persons following an incident on August 19 that resulted in deaths.
verification_notes: Public summary did not provide a full casualty breakdown or clear attribution.
uncertainties: Public summary did not provide a full casualty breakdown or clear attribution.

items.title_cn: 尼日尔州Borgu地区清真寺及村庄遭袭，多名民众被绑架
items.title_original: Gunmen abduct worshippers and villagers in Niger State mosque-area attacks
items.summary_cn: 武装人员袭击尼日尔州Borgu地方政府区多个社区，并在周五礼拜期间绑架清真寺中的礼拜者；警方及当地最初报告无法确认最终被绑架人数。
items.summary_original: Gunmen attacked communities in Borgu Local Government Area and abducted worshippers during Friday prayers. Initial police and local reports could not confirm the final number abducted.
verification_notes: Exact number of abductees was initially unconfirmed.
uncertainties: Exact number of abductees was initially unconfirmed.

items.title_cn: 中国与非盟签署援助非洲扫雷物资交接证书
items.title_original: China and African Union sign handover certificate for demining assistance
items.summary_cn: 中国驻非盟使团与非盟委员会签署中国援助非洲扫雷物资交接证书，中方将该项目定位为支持非洲和平与安全能力建设的一部分。
items.summary_original: China's mission to the African Union and the AU Commission signed a handover certificate for Chinese demining assistance, framed as support for African peace and security capacity-building.

source_links.source_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China

source_groups: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China

items.title_cn: 刚果（金）政府与AFC/M23就和平谈判路线图达成一致
items.title_original: DRC government and AFC/M23 agree roadmap for peace negotiations
items.summary_cn: 在8月17日至21日瑞士会谈后，刚果（金）政府与AFC/M23代表同意在多哈框架下制定分阶段谈判路线图、建立落实审查机制，并统一停火违规指控的报告方式。
items.summary_original: After talks in Switzerland from August 17 to 21, representatives of the DRC government and AFC/M23 agreed a sequenced roadmap for negotiations under the Doha Framework, a review mechanism, and standardized reporting of alleged ceasefire violations.
verification_notes: The agreement did not itself end fighting and implementation remained uncertain.
uncertainties: The agreement did not itself end fighting and implementation remained uncertain.

items.title_cn: 摩加迪沙争议拆迁引发居民抗议与枪火冲突
items.title_original: Clashes erupt in Mogadishu during contested home demolitions
items.summary_cn: 索马里安全力量在摩加迪沙Tookiyo社区执行房屋拆除行动时遭居民抵制。当地报道提到发生枪火并有近10人受伤；部分媒体还报道死亡情况，但尚未独立证实。
items.summary_original: Security forces conducting demolitions in Tookiyo faced resistance from residents. Local reports described gunfire and nearly 10 injuries; fatalities were reported by some outlets but were not independently confirmed.
verification_notes: Casualty figures and legal ownership claims were disputed and not independently verified.
uncertainties: Casualty figures and legal ownership claims were disputed and not independently verified.

items.title_cn: 南苏丹琼莱州联合国巡逻队遭伏击，两名维和人员死亡
items.title_original: Two UN peacekeepers killed in ambush in South Sudan's Jonglei State
items.summary_cn: 身份不明武装人员伏击前往Pajut的联合国南苏丹特派团巡逻队，造成2名埃塞俄比亚籍维和人员死亡、7人受伤，伤者包括维和人员、南苏丹警察和文职人员。
items.summary_original: Unidentified armed men ambushed an UNMISS patrol travelling to Pajut, killing two Ethiopian peacekeepers and injuring seven others, including peacekeepers, South Sudanese police and civilian staff.
items.location: En route to Pajut, Jonglei State
items.location_name: En route to Pajut, Jonglei State
verification_notes: No group had claimed responsibility at publication time.
uncertainties: No group had claimed responsibility at publication time.

items.title_cn: 美国推动将联合国武器禁运扩大至苏丹全国
items.title_original: United States pushes to expand UN arms embargo across all of Sudan
items.summary_cn: 美国在联合国安理会推动将现有针对达尔富尔的武器禁运扩大至苏丹全境，并明确涵盖无人机，理由是外部支持正在加剧战争并提高冲突外溢风险。
items.summary_original: At the UN Security Council, the United States urged expansion of the existing Darfur arms embargo to cover all of Sudan, including drones, arguing external support was deepening the war and increasing regional spillover risks.
verification_notes: The proposal required Security Council agreement and faced opposition from some members.
uncertainties: The proposal required Security Council agreement and faced opposition from some members.

items.title_cn: 坦桑尼亚副总统Emmanuel Nchimbi宣布辞职并退出政坛
items.title_original: Tanzania Vice President Emmanuel Nchimbi resigns and retires from politics
items.summary_cn: 坦桑尼亚副总统Emmanuel Nchimbi宣布辞去职务并退出公共服务和政治活动，自9月4日起生效；他表示自己相信总统Samia Suluhu Hassan希望作出调整。
items.summary_original: Vice President Emmanuel Nchimbi announced his resignation from office and retirement from public service and active politics, effective September 4, saying he believed President Samia Suluhu Hassan wanted a change.
verification_notes: Public reporting referred to political divisions, but the exact internal political context was not fully established.
uncertainties: Public reporting referred to political divisions, but the exact internal political context was not fully established.

items.title_cn: 索马里最高法院撤销Galmudug选举结果并下令重新投票
items.title_original: Somalia Supreme Court annuls Galmudug election results and orders fresh vote
items.summary_cn: 索马里最高法院撤销7月30日Galmudug议会及地方议会选举结果，认定严重程序和法律违规损害选举合法性；选举委员会随后表示将执行判决。
items.summary_original: Somalia's Supreme Court annulled the July 30 Galmudug parliamentary and local council election results, ruling that serious procedural and legal violations undermined the vote. The electoral commission later said it would comply.

items.title_cn: 乌干达军方负责人Muhoozi Kainerugaba宣布计划参加2031年总统选举
items.title_original: Uganda army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba says he will run for president in 2031
items.summary_cn: 乌干达军方负责人、总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼之子Muhoozi Kainerugaba表示将参加2031年总统选举，使长期存在的权力接班议题进一步明朗化。
items.summary_original: Uganda's military chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of President Yoweri Museveni, said he planned to stand for the presidency in 2031, intensifying long-running speculation over succession.
verification_notes: The statement concerns a future candidacy and does not determine the eventual succession outcome.
uncertainties: The statement concerns a future candidacy and does not determine the eventual succession outcome.

items.title_cn: 苏丹医疗组织指称SPLM-N在南科尔多凡杀害27名平民
items.title_original: Sudanese medical group accuses SPLM-N of killing 27 civilians in South Kordofan
items.summary_cn: Sudan Doctors Network指称，SPLM-N在南科尔多凡Qardud和Abu Hamama地区杀害至少27名平民，其中包括4名儿童。
items.summary_original: The Sudan Doctors Network accused the SPLM-N of killing at least 27 civilians, including four children, in Qardud and Abu Hamama in South Kordofan amid ethnic violence and the wider civil war.
items.location: Qardud and Abu Hamama, South Kordofan
items.location_name: Qardud and Abu Hamama, South Kordofan
verification_notes: Casualty and attribution claims were allegations by the Sudan Doctors Network and were not independently verified in the cited AP report.
uncertainties: Casualty and attribution claims were allegations by the Sudan Doctors Network and were not independently verified in the cited AP report.

items.title_cn: 几内亚比绍准备举行宪法公投，新宪法将扩大总统权力
items.title_original: Guinea-Bissau prepares referendum on constitution expanding presidential powers
items.summary_cn: 军方执政的几内亚比绍准备于8月30日举行宪法公投；拟议新宪法将扩大总统对总理、内阁及议会的权力，并为12月计划举行的选举建立新制度框架。
items.summary_original: Military-led Guinea-Bissau prepared for an August 30 constitutional referendum that would expand presidential authority, including powers over the prime minister, cabinet and parliament, ahead of planned elections in December.
verification_notes: This record describes the referendum plan before voting took place.
uncertainties: This record describes the referendum plan before voting took place.

items.title_cn: 乍得将相关地区戒备提升至最高级别，苏丹跨境打击争议引发外溢担忧
items.title_original: Chad raises alert to highest level as Sudan strike dispute draws wider concern
items.summary_cn: 乍得表示，在指责苏丹实施此前跨境打击后，已将相关地区戒备提升至最高级别；美国和非盟也警告苏丹战争向周边国家扩散的风险。
items.summary_original: Chad said it had raised alert levels in the affected area to the highest point after accusing Sudan of the earlier strike. The United States and African Union also warned against regional spillover from Sudan's war.
verification_notes: Responsibility for the original strike remained disputed.
uncertainties: Responsibility for the original strike remained disputed.
